upstream.description: Claude Code learns from your corrections: self-correcting memory that compounds over 50+ sessions. Context engineering, parallel worktrees, agent teams, and 17 battle-tested skills.

classification.analysis: Pro Workflow is a Claude Code plugin (also installable into 30+ agents via `skills add`) that layers a SQLite-backed self-correcting memory, FTS5-indexed research wikis, and quality-gate hooks on top of coding sessions, so corrections become durable rules and research persists across sessions. It ships 41 skills, 8 agents, 23 commands, and 37 hook scripts covering things like cost tracking, permission tuning, and a budget-capped auto-research loop with multi-LLM council deliberation. Aimed at heavy Claude Code / Cursor users who want cross-session memory and knowledge accumulation instead of losing context on every compaction.

use_cases.title: Give Claude Code persistent memory of corrections across sessions
Build a searchable research wiki inside a coding agent
Track token cost and permission denials for agent sessions
